fr_html: Le PRESIDENT veut ajouter à cette formule, entre les mots „sont" et „fondées", le mot „suffisamment".
en_html:
The PRESIDENT wished to add the word "sufficiently" to the expression "well-founded".

This proposal was rejected by a vote.
